title: Digital Forensics 8H Foundation
purpose: A practical foundation for reasoning about digital evidence, preservation, common host and network artifacts, bounded investigations, and defensible reporting.
learningOutcomes: Describe a bounded digital-forensics workflow and its evidence and legal-organization limits.
Plan acquisition, preservation, integrity verification, write-protection, and custody activities.
Interpret common disk, filesystem, Windows, memory, network, and log artifacts without treating one artifact as conclusive.
Construct timelines and investigation hypotheses that account for clock, visibility, and corroboration limits.
Produce a structured technical and executive reporting plan for a synthetic investigation.
breakPolicy: Breaks and administration are outside the 480 content minutes.
